judgment_calls.decision: 'Throat symptoms' anchored to the common symptom Sore throat for every rule.
judgment_calls.alternatives: An or of sore throat, difficulty/painful swallowing; rejected because Unable to swallow must then be checked for in its own due_to family.

judgment_calls.decision: Encoded both inside the Urgent priority and as a possible Anaphylaxis diagnosis ("check for anaphylaxis 28").
judgment_calls.alternatives: Treat as cross_reference_only; rejected because the bullet lists its own criteria inside the urgent box.

judgment_calls.decision: and of Pharyngeal swelling and Upper respiratory tract obstruction.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Upper respiratory tract obstruction alone (broader) or Pharyngeal swelling alone (fires on any swelling).

judgment_calls.decision: No branch of the tonsil question, with red throat required when tonsils are not swollen; tender neck lymph nodes not required.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Requiring all features in the viral box (too narrow) or the No branch alone (fires on any sore throat without swollen tonsils).

judgment_calls.decision: Bacterial and viral rules require a recorded negative for pseudomembrane in both pharynx and nose.
